brief_id: Patroli melihat asap tipis di lahan gambut bekas terbakar di sel riau-0533, 48 jam setelah api terlihat padam. Mohon kirim regu untuk memeriksa dan memadamkan bara di bawah permukaan.
brief_en: A patrol saw smoke wisps on burned peat in cell riau-0533, 48 hours after the fire looked out. Please send a crew to check and put out any fire below the surface.

timeline.text: Patrol Dedi asked to recheck by 1 Aug.
